findings.identity_explanation: All records use the exact tag PMP-03. Model AQ-CW75 and location Basement 1 pump room agree across CR:PMP-03, ES:PMP-03, FM:TFM-0109 and COM-05. Serial AQ75-3303 agrees across CR:PMP-03, COM-05 and WAR-06. Only the second FM row TFM-0111 differs, on location.

exceptions.finding: The FM register has two rows for PMP-03 (TFM-0109 and TFM-0111), both with the same PPM plan.
exceptions.next_action: Review the two FM rows and decide internally which to keep or merge. Both are left unchanged by this tool.

exceptions.finding: FM:TFM-0111 puts PMP-03 in Basement 2 pump room. The construction register, equipment schedule, commissioning certificate and FM:TFM-0109 all say Basement 1 pump room. The contractor documents are consistent, so this looks like an FM register error, but the FM team should confirm.

evidence.quote: Asset: PMP-03 | Model: AQ-CW75 | Serial: AQ75-3303 | Location: Basement 1 pump room

exceptions.next_action: Correct or remove the FM row with the wrong location (Readiness 5.5). No contractor request is needed unless the FM team doubts the installed location.

findings.summary: PMP-03 has signed, passing commissioning (COM-05), a matching-serial warranty to 2028-10-08 (WAR-06), an O&M manual (OM-04) and a PPM plan. It cannot be Ready for review because the FM register holds two PMP-03 rows, one of which gives a conflicting location (Basement 2 vs Basement 1). The fix is internal to the FM CAFM administrator.
uncertainties: Which FM row (TFM-0109 or TFM-0111) is the intended record is for the FM team to decide; no source states why the second row exists.
Physical location was not verified on site; Basement 1 is supported by CR, ES, COM-05 and FM:TFM-0109 only.
